name: switch-case
description: Deterministic value-based branching. A classifier phase emits a discrete verdict (approve / revise / reject) and the `switch` runs the exactly-matching case, with `default` as the catch-all. Use this when a phase (a script or agent) returns true/false or x/y/z and cases should fire off that value — distinct from `route`, which can use an LLM router or loose substring matching.
